6: /// Response that redirects the request to another location.
7: ///
8: /// # Example
9: ///
10: /// ```rust
11: /// use axum::{
12: ///     routing::get,
13: ///     response::Redirect,
14: ///     Router,
15: /// };
16: ///
17: /// let app = Router::new()
18: ///     .route("/old", get(|| async { Redirect::permanent("/new".parse().unwrap()) }))
19: ///     .route("/new", get(|| async { "Hello!" }));
20: /// # async {
21: /// # hyper::Server::bind(&"".parse().unwrap()).serve(app.into_make_service()).await.unwrap();
22: /// # };
23: /// ```
24: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
25: pub struct Redirect {
26:     pub(crate) status_code: StatusCode,
27:     pub(crate) location: HeaderValue,
28: }
29: 
30: impl Redirect {
31:     /// Create a new [`Redirect`] that uses a [`303 See Other`][mdn] status code.
32:     ///
33:     /// This redirect instructs the client to change the method to GET for the subsequent request
34:     /// to the given `uri`, which is useful after successful form submission, file upload or when
35:     /// you generally don't want the redirected-to page to observe the original request method and
36:     /// body (if non-empty).
37:     ///
38:     /// # Panics
39:     ///
40:     /// If `uri` isn't a valid [`HeaderValue`].
41:     ///
42:     /// [mdn]: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/303
43:     pub fn to(uri: Uri) -> Self {
44:         Self::with_status_code(StatusCode::SEE_OTHER, uri)
45:     }
46: 
47:     /// Create a new [`Redirect`] that uses a [`307 Temporary Redirect`][mdn] status code.
48:     ///
49:     /// This has the same behavior as [`Redirect::to`], except it will preserve the original HTTP
50:     /// method and body.
51:     ///
52:     /// # Panics
53:     ///
54:     /// If `uri` isn't a valid [`HeaderValue`].
55:     ///
56:     /// [mdn]: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/307
57:     pub fn temporary(uri: Uri) -> Self {
58:         Self::with_status_code(StatusCode::TEMPORARY_REDIRECT, uri)
59:     }
60: 
61:     /// Create a new [`Redirect`] that uses a [`308 Permanent Redirect`][mdn] status code.
62:     ///
63:     /// # Panics
64:     ///
65:     /// If `uri` isn't a valid [`HeaderValue`].
66:     ///
67:     /// [mdn]: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/308
68:     pub fn permanent(uri: Uri) -> Self {
69:         Self::with_status_code(StatusCode::PERMANENT_REDIRECT, uri)
70:     }
71: 
72:     /// Create a new [`Redirect`] that uses a [`302 Found`][mdn] status code.
73:     ///
74:     /// This is the same as [`Redirect::temporary`], except the status code is older and thus
75:     /// supported by some legacy applications that doesn't understand the newer one, but some of
76:     /// those applications wrongly apply [`Redirect::to`] (`303 See Other`) semantics for this
77:     /// status code. It should be avoided where possible.
78:     ///
79:     /// # Panics
80:     ///
81:     /// If `uri` isn't a valid [`HeaderValue`].
82:     ///
83:     /// [mdn]: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/302
84:     pub fn found(uri: Uri) -> Self {
85:         Self::with_status_code(StatusCode::FOUND, uri)
86:     }
87: 
88:     // This is intentionally not public since other kinds of redirects might not
89:     // use the `Location` header, namely `304 Not Modified`.
90:     //
91:     // We're open to adding more constructors upon request, if they make sense :)
92:     pub(crate) fn with_status_code(status_code: StatusCode, uri: Uri) -> Self {
93:         assert!(
94:             status_code.is_redirection(),
95:             "not a redirection status code"
96:         );
97: 
98:         Self {
99:             status_code,
100:             location: HeaderValue::try_from(uri.to_string())
101:                 .expect("URI isn't a valid header value"),
102:         }
103:     }
104: }
105: 
106: impl IntoResponse for Redirect {
107:     fn into_response(self) -> Response {
108:         let mut res = Response::new(boxed(Empty::new()));
109:         *res.status_mut() = self.status_code;
110:         res.headers_mut().insert(LOCATION, self.location);
111:         res
112:     }
113: }
